content: For each configurable interface SoAd shall determine the func- tion name by replacing the tag <Up> with the module name abbreviation of the related upper layer module (as specified in the SoAdBSWModules container using the SoAd- BswModuleRef reference parameter) and using the two infix according to the configu- ration parameters SoAdUseCallerInfix and SoAdUseTypeInfix.
